textRun.content: How to Find World-Class Compounders — and Never Overpay
1,175 Developed Stocks  →  225 Prime Grade (19.1%)  →  100% Deterministic Mauboussin-Fade DCF

Welcome to the Quality and Moat Screener v7.19 walkthrough. The whole system rests on one rule: first decide which businesses deserve a 20-year hold, and only then let pure accounting math tell you what price is fair.
Sources: S&P 500 ∪ Nasdaq-100 (US), STOXX Europe 600 (EU), S&P/TSX 60 (CA)
Munger Inversion: Sequential rejection; hunt fatal flaws.
Buffett Owner Earnings: Cash moats; no "kindness of strangers."
Sleep & Thorndike (Outsiders): Scale economies shared + allocation.
Mauboussin CAP & Fade: 5–30Y runway + base-rate fade.
Zero Analyst Overrides: Gates (gates.py) separate from DCF.

Our 1,175-stock universe covers Europe, the US, and Canada. Five investing masters shape the rules: Munger's inversion, Buffett's Owner Earnings and solvency, Nick Sleep and Will Thorndike on capital allocation, Mauboussin on competitive advantage duration, and zero manual DCF overrides.
Blank Gate Rule: 0 unreviewed gates across all 1,175 companies (100% evaluated)
• Y: Western rule-of-law (US, CA, UK, CH, Nordics, W. Europe).
• Deposit Banks (10–15× lev., duration mismatch) → G6 = N.
• Fail at G1, G2, or G3 stops immediately.
• All 483 G3-passers get full G4–G6 scores.
• Scored even if failed at G4 (<15Y) or G5 (0).

Before Gate 1 even begins, pre-screens flag weak property-rights markets like Greece or Poland for Gate 2, and structurally leveraged deposit banks and capped utilities for Gate 6. Early rejects stop at Gates 1 to 3, while all 483 moat franchises receive full diagnostic scores across Gates 4 to 6.
506 firms lack moat or real pricing power

Look at how brutal Charlie Munger's inversion is in practice: 81 percent of the world's largest companies are eliminated. Gate 3 is the biggest choke point, cutting 506 businesses—43.1 percent of the starting universe—because they lack an enduring moat or pricing power above inflation.
Multi-cycle track record & verifiable statements (incl. clean banks, insurers, holdcos).
Pre-profit/unproven models & opaque B/S (prop trading, crypto treasuries, binary biotech).
Functional needs + Buffett "likely to spend" habits & Lindy luxury; low legislative risk.
Deferrable cyclicals (cruises, airlines, builders), commodity explorers, pariah, tobacco/CFD.

Gate 1 enforces circle of competence and financial verifiability, cutting binary biotech and opaque prop trading. Gate 2 applies Buffett and Munger's likely-to-spend test: it keeps necessities, daily rituals, and Lindy luxury while rejecting deferrable cyclicals, commodity explorers, pariah states, and predatory models.
✓ Gate 3b Empirical Proof-of-Moat Hurdle (3b = Y required alongside 3a ≠ None)
5Y Median GAAP ROIC ≥ 12% (or Tangible ROIC ≥ 15%) AND Incremental ROIIC ≥ 12% + Real Pricing Power ≥ Inflation.

Every surviving franchise must score on at least one of four moat archetypes: Toll Booths, Irreplaceable Infrastructure, strictly Nick Sleep's Scale Economies Shared—like Costco passing savings to shoppers—or R&D Leadership. Gate 3b also requires hard proof via 12 percent ROIC, 12 percent incremental ROIIC, and inflation-beating pricing power.
−108 rejected at Gate 4 (−9.2%)  |  375 firms clear CAP ≥ 15Y  |  Zero manual CAP overrides
STEP 1 · Initial CAP from Gate 3 (m_max, m_sum)
• 4_ent, 4_riv, 4_buy, 4_sup, 4_sub ∈ {0,1,2} vs AI, Demo, Geopolitics, Energy, Inflation & Clock Speed (fast tech/pharma 4_sub ≥ 1).
3 Anti-Drift Rules:  (1) Sub-Industry Peer Benchmarking  ·  (2) UI Seat Layer (2) vs Proprietary Data/Statutory Engine (1)  ·  (3) Gate Orthogonality (zero G5/G6 bleed into G4)

Gate 4 separates how strong a moat is today from how fast disruption is moving. Step 1 sets initial CAP from 15 to 30 years using Gate 3 scores. Step 2 stress-tests Porter's 5 Forces against 5 macrotrends and Mauboussin's Clock Speed: moderate forces shave 5 to 15 years, while any fatal flaw rated 2 caps runway at 10 years or less.
Compound to new highs across cycles.
Net Debt/OE ≤ 4.0y, EBIT/Int > 5.0× (infra & Solvency II > 200% contextual).

Even a great moat fails if management wastes capital or loads up on debt. Gate 5 grades 5 superinvestor stewardship vectors and eliminates 16 companies. Gate 6 eliminates 134 more because of shrinking cycle peaks, weak cash conversion below 80 percent, or leverage exceeding 4 years of Owner Earnings.
Slump-Cannibal Compounder Doctrine: 100% deterministic from audited statements — zero overrides
Owner EPS = (NI + max(0, min(clean_DA, max(0, OCF − NI)) − CapEx − 0.20 × AvgLease)) / Shares
OCF − NI caps non-cash D&A; no fake accruals.
Looks through 1Y sales_1y slumps using multi-cycle growth. When cur_eps < peak, blend weight decays linearly: w = 50% (peak ≤ 1y old) → 33% (2y) → 17% (3y) → 0% (≥ 4y).

Accounting Net Income can be distorted by non-cash charges or stale boom years, so Owner EPS measures true cash earnings. Part II computes intrinsic value purely from audited statements with zero analyst overrides: Owner EPS caps depreciation add-backs by operating cash flow minus net income, strips 1.5x impairment spikes and pre-IPO noise, deducts 20 percent of IFRS-16 leases, and decays stale earnings peaks to zero over four years.
RONIC₀ bounded to [5.0%, 50.0%]  |  Prevents serial cash-acquirer ROIC inflation
• Cash Acquirers (ma_reinvest > 0): harmonic blend of r_tang & r_GAAP via w = clip(ma_reinvest × r_GAAP / g₀, 0, 1).
• Stock Deals: penalized via Share Index S_t. RONIC₀ bounded to [5%, 50%].

To measure return on new capital fairly, the model picks the right capital base by sector: tangible operating ROIC with a one-third invested-capital floor for operating firms, 5-year ROE for banks, insurers, and negative-capital clearinghouses, and GAAP ROIC for concessions. Serial cash acquirers get harmonically blended down toward GAAP ROIC.
10Y audited history  |  Outlier-resistant non-parametric statistics  |  Pure organic firm growth
Penalizes SBC & stock M&A share growth in exact year (10Y).
Log-slopes Δt ≥ 5y; outputs P50 median & conservative P25.
Balances Rev, NOPAT & Owner EPS (6% refranchising cap).
Shrinks (τ₀=6%) toward 3.0%; smooth tanh cap at 13.0%.
Buyback Discipline (Kept Strictly Outside Firm-Level DCF)
Net buyback yield (bb_eff) is clamped to [−3.0%, +3.5%] and excluded from DCF growth g₀, preventing leverage-driven financial engineering from inflating fair value.

Rather than trusting noisy short-term surges, the model extracts durable organic growth and gently pulls extreme outliers back toward normal. Growth g0 comes from a four-pillar statistical pipeline over 10 years of statements: a dilution-only share index, cycle-spanning Theil-Sen slopes over 5-plus-year spans to ignore 1-year COVID flukes, three-driver triangulation across revenue, NOPAT, and Owner EPS, and Empirical Bayes shrinkage toward 3 percent inflation capped smoothly at 13 percent.
Stage 1 explicit fade (t = 1..CAP) + Stage 2 McKinsey terminal value at 3.0% inflation
E₁ = 1.0 × Active EPS. Discount rate r = 8.50% (operating) or 10.25% (BS financials).
g_t → min(g₀, 3.0%); RONIC_t → min(RONIC₀, 20%, r+0.5(RONIC₀−r)); FCF_t = E_t(1−g_t/RONIC_t).
Exact math guarantee: when RONIC = r, Fair P/E ≡ 1 / r (11.76× op / 9.76× fin) for any g₀.

In Step 4, excess growth and returns fade linearly over the Gate 4 Competitive Advantage Period. High returns only create value when RONIC exceeds the hurdle rate: if a business only earns 8.5 percent, growing faster adds zero extra value and its Fair P/E stays locked at 1 divided by 8.5 percent, or 11.76 times.
Exact formula 0g / 3% max terminal P/E: 15.45× operating  |  11.72× BS financials
Current Price vs Fair Value vs 0g Floor (3% inflation, max 15.45× op / 11.72× BS fin; zero-spread 11.76× / 9.76×).
Solves exact IRR across FCF₁..FCF₅ + Year-5 DCF continuation V₅. Guaranteed lock: IRR == r iff Price == Fair Value.
Scans [−20%, +50%] grid + bisection to invert market-implied growth g_market & Market-Implied CAP from today's quote.

Step 5 turns Fair Value into three practical decision anchors. Notice the 0g floor ceiling: at 3 percent inflation and a 20 percent terminal RONIC cap, operating companies cap at (1 - 3%/20%)/(8.5% - 3%) = 15.45x, while Balance-Sheet Financials at a 10.25% hurdle cap at the exact formula ceiling (1 - 3%/20%)/(10.25% - 3%) = 11.72x (superseding the earlier 10.89x draft ref)—individual insurers like MUV2.DE at 18.2% RONIC0 sit at 10.88x and HNR1.DE at 19.0% RONIC0 sit at 10.97x. Reverse-DCF flips the model to ask what growth today's price already assumes.
Price date 2026-11-17  |  Prime Grade median excess 5Y IRR vs hurdle: −11.7pp
Clears all 6 Munger gates (< 3 G6 flags).
Quality Grade, Valued, g₀ ≥ 5.0%, g_mkt < 5.0% (9 Prime, 6 G6-fail, 10 CAP 5–10Y).
Structural moat cohort passing G1, G2 & G3 (< 3 G6 flags).
• Full watchlist for deep cycle pullbacks.

Surviving companies organize into three actionable cohorts. Prime Grade holds the 225 top-tier compounders. Quality Grade tracks all 443 structural moats for pullback watchlists. Growth at ~0g spots 25 mispriced compounders growing at least 5 percent organically while priced below 5 percent—such as Zoetis at +22.4 percent IRR, Partners Group at +16.5 percent, and Progressive at +18.3 percent.
Live Case Studies: Quality vs. Price
Great businesses can be expensive stocks (COST, ASML.NL, WM)  |  CRM blocked by Gate 4 AI Fatal Flaw

These six real companies prove why quality and price must be judged separately. Costco, ASML, and Waste Management are wonderful 25-to-30-year moats, yet their stock prices assume 16 to 24 percent growth and yield negative 5-year IRRs. Salesforce looks cheap at 17.8x earnings until Gate 4 flags AI seat-compression as a fatal flaw. Only Microsoft passes all gates and clears the 8.5 percent hurdle at +10.3 percent IRR.

Check Current Price vs DCF Fair Value & 0g Terminal Floor.
Require Bellman 5Y IRR > 8.50% (10.25% BS fin) before buying.
“Tell me where I am going to die, so I never go there.” — Charlie Munger
Patience pays: wait inside the 225 Prime Grade & 25 Growth-at-0g names until Mr. Market hands you a double-digit 5Y IRR.

To use the screener every week, just follow four steps: start inside the 225 Prime Grade or 25 Growth at ~0g cohorts, invert market-implied growth against g0, anchor to Fair Value and the 0g floor, and wait patiently until 5-year IRR clears your hurdle rate.
